stoutford_old_woman.m: So young and already hanging around in taverns?
r: No, I am looking for my brother Andor. Maybe you have seen him?
At least I am not drinking whole bottles on my own, like that guy at the next table.

stoutford_old_woman_10.m: Yes, I have seen a boy that looks a bit like you. Not too long ago. But he is gone and I can not say where he was bound to.
r: What a pity. At least someone has seen him. Better than nothing.

stoutford_old_woman_20.m: Well said. I hope for your sake that you will choose other amusements.
r: He looks rather well off. Who is he?

stoutford_old_woman_22.m: That is Lord Bourbon ... - I mean Lord Berbane of Stoutford. His name invites a nasty pun, but honestly, he does not do much to show a different character.

stoutford_old_woman_30.m: Lord Bourbon sits there every evening, drinking or telling fairy tales. Or he plays his lute and sings to it. I must admit he has a reasonable voice.
r: He is the heir to Stoutford Castle?

stoutford_old_woman_40.m: Correct, although there is not much in the way of heirlooms left. And the castle is almost in ruins now, after the raid.

stoutford_old_woman_50.m: And now you should run home and go to bed. Your parents should take better care of you and your brothers.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
